description: Final-year electrical and electronics engineering student at Karabük University. Embedded systems, circuit simulation, and hardware testing. Explore the interactive signal bench or download my CV.
intro: I’m a final-year student at Karabük University. I’m looking for a graduate role in embedded systems, electronics design or hardware testing.
heroIntro: I’m a final-year student at Karabük University. My coursework spans embedded systems, circuit design and hardware testing.
benchIntro: Choose a model and adjust its input to see how the waveform changes.
fallback: Enable JavaScript to adjust the models.

models.title: Lissajous Figure
models.label: Phase offset
models.desc: Two sinusoidal voltages drive the horizontal and vertical axes. The bright line is the selected phase. The fainter lines trace the preceding 60° of the sweep.

models.title: Building a Square Wave
models.label: Odd harmonics
models.desc: Add odd harmonics of a 1 kHz sine wave to approximate a square wave. More terms sharpen the edges, while a small overshoot persists near each jump. The sum runs over k = 1, 3, …, 2N − 1.

models.title: Charging a Capacitor
models.label: Capacitance
models.desc: A 1 V step charges an initially empty capacitor through a 10 kΩ resistor. At one time constant, τ = RC, the capacitor voltage reaches about 63.2% of its final value. Increase C to slow the response.

models.title: Voltage from a Rotating Coil
models.label: Rotation speed
models.desc: A 100-turn coil of area 20 cm² rotates in a uniform 0.1 T field. The magnetic flux through each turn is BA cos(ωt). Doubling the speed doubles both the frequency and the peak open-circuit voltage.

practiceIntro: My engineering experience comes from coursework and laboratory work at Karabük University.

skills.title: Circuits & Measurement
skills.body: I simulate analogue and digital circuits, then use an oscilloscope and signal generator to examine their behaviour in the lab.

skills.title: Embedded Systems
skills.body: I study microprocessor architecture and write hardware-level code in C and 8-bit assembly. My interests include microcontrollers and sensor interfaces.

skills.title: Signal & Control
skills.body: I use MATLAB to model signals and control systems. My electrical machines coursework covers energy conversion and the principles behind motor operation.

discipline: BSc in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
educationText: Final year of a degree taught entirely in English. Coursework includes analogue and digital electronics, microprocessors, signal processing, control systems and electrical machines.
trainingText: Earned a certificate by examination after a training programme run by Uludoğan Savunma Sanayii Teknoloji Şirketi and Karabük University’s Defence Technologies Club (KARSAV).
moreToolsText: AutoCAD, basic PCB reading, sensor and integrated circuit applications.
